diagnosis: Proof-led verified-human static ads are earning strong attention and engaged landing visits from AI Labs and model-evaluation buyers on LinkedIn, with repeat engagement building from named accounts.
recommended_action: Scale this proof-led execution to additional Builder segments and add a second verification proof point (representativeness, QC methodology) to the next variant.

diagnosis: Inside technical publications, the same proof-led framing is producing the deepest content progression in the portfolio — evaluation teams are reading past the hook into the verification methodology.
recommended_action: Extend the carousel into a longer-form technical explainer for the same environment; content progression suggests appetite for more depth.

diagnosis: Event-surround placements are building qualified reach around the target conference window, but content progression is flat — this format is doing an awareness job, not a proof job.
recommended_action: Keep event amplification focused on reach and save proof-density variants for retargeting after the event.

diagnosis: The broad human-feedback display variant is retargeting well on high-intent behavior, but engagement quality is the weakest in the Verified Human Network set — the generic framing isn't earning attention on its own.
recommended_action: Retire the broad-awareness display variant in this environment and replace it with a proof-led retargeting cutdown before adding more spend.

diagnosis: Community-hosted proof carousels are converting attention into deeper engagement at a similar rate to LinkedIn, reinforcing that verification credibility travels across Builder environments.
recommended_action: Standardize the proof-led carousel structure as the default Verified Human Network unit for all Builder-facing environments.

diagnosis: The workflow-diagram document ad is a low-reach, high-depth execution: engineering teams who click are reading through the full integration story, and high-intent behavior is building.
recommended_action: Keep this as a narrow, high-fit unit; do not broaden targeting — instead build a second workflow variant for the model-evaluation stage of the pipeline.

diagnosis: High-intent page activity is climbing fastest here of any API/MCP execution, suggesting community placements are catching evaluators actively comparing integration options.
recommended_action: Prioritize this environment for the next MCP-specific landing page test and add comparison content to convert the rising intent.

diagnosis: A stat-led, integration-benefit static on LinkedIn is underperforming its own prior period across every signal — the abstract statistic isn't earning the credibility that the workflow-led document ad does.
recommended_action: Replace the stat-led static with a workflow-led adaptation and reserve LinkedIn for the format that is already working.

diagnosis: Search placements around integration and comparison queries are producing the strongest high-intent page activity in the Builder portfolio, even at a small scale.
recommended_action: Increase investment in comparison-led search creative before broadening the Verified Human Network message into this channel.

diagnosis: The before/after creative-confidence framing that performs well with Creators is flat to slightly declining with Builder audiences — real-time reaction isn't the credibility driver this segment needs.
recommended_action: Deprioritize real-time-input messaging for Builders in favor of verification and workflow-integration framing.

diagnosis: This is the weakest-performing execution in the current dataset across every signal, confirming that real-time human input is not a credible category-creation hook for technical Builder audiences.
recommended_action: Retire this variant rather than refresh it; redirect the budget to a proof-led Verified Human Network display unit in the same environment.

diagnosis: The before/after carousel is the strongest-performing execution in the portfolio for Creators — seeing AI-generated work change after real human reaction is producing the deepest content progression measured to date.
recommended_action: Scale before/after variants across additional creative-team use cases and add a second proof point built around brand and product teams specifically.

diagnosis: Creative-team audiences inside AI-community environments are engaging with the before/after format almost as strongly as on LinkedIn, extending the finding beyond a single channel.
recommended_action: Add a native before/after variant to the always-on AI Community rotation rather than treating it as a LinkedIn-only unit.

diagnosis: Retargeting the before/after story on programmatic display is converting attention into rising high-intent behavior, extending the message into the consideration stage.
recommended_action: Build a retargeting-specific before/after cutdown that leads with the product moment closest to the viewer's likely use case.

diagnosis: Around the target event window, the narrative-led static is holding steady on reach and awareness but isn't yet building the deeper engagement the LinkedIn and AI Community units are producing.
recommended_action: Use event surround for awareness only, then route attendees to a before/after retargeting variant after the event.

diagnosis: Even in a technical-media environment built for Builders, the before/after story earns strong content progression when the audience is innovation-team Creators — the format's strength travels, the environment fit is what shifts.
recommended_action: Route Creator-specific media buys in technical environments to before/after creative rather than reusing Builder-oriented proof units.

diagnosis: Verification messaging earns moderate attention from Creators but content progression is meaningfully lower than the same proof-led format performs with Builder audiences.
recommended_action: Keep a light always-on verification presence for Creators, but do not prioritize new proof-led production for this audience over before/after variants.

diagnosis: Signals are essentially flat period over period — the proof-led static is a stable, low-priority unit for brand-team Creators rather than a growth lever.
recommended_action: Hold current spend; do not scale until the before/after format's Programmatic performance plateaus.

diagnosis: The workflow-integration story has almost no pull with Creator audiences — this is the lowest-engagement pairing in the dataset, consistent with API/MCP being a technical-buyer topic.
recommended_action: Stop producing API/MCP variants for Creator audiences; reallocate the production slot to a before/after or proof-led unit.

diagnosis: Consistent with the technical-media result, an integration-focused stat unit is not resonating with Creator audiences in AI-community environments either.
recommended_action: Treat API/MCP as a Builder-only topic going forward; do not fund a third Creator-facing variant without a different core message.

diagnosis: Verification-and-comparison search creative is producing the highest high-intent page activity of any Verified Human Network execution, signaling buyers are actively vetting vendors on trust criteria.
recommended_action: Fund a dedicated comparison landing page for verification criteria and route this search variant directly to it.

diagnosis: Search intent for Creators is rising fastest around before/after and workflow-comparison queries, suggesting active tool evaluation is starting to include a creative-QA angle.
recommended_action: Add a before/after-specific search ad group tied to comparison and alternative-tool queries.
